# Ziquala Abo School

> Public information about Ziquala Abo School in Bishoftu, Ethiopia, and Ziquala Abo Monastery.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://ziquala.com/): School and monastery overview.
- [School](https://ziquala.com/school): School purpose, leadership, staff, and campuses.
- [Monastery](https://ziquala.com/monastery): History, heritage, and community projects.
- [E-learning](https://ziquala.com/elearning): Published learning materials.
- [News](https://ziquala.com/news): Published announcements and events.
- [Contact](https://ziquala.com/contact): Contact information and enquiry form.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://ziquala.com/sitemap.xml): Indexable public pages.
- [Resource catalog](https://ziquala.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Public resource links in JSON.

Student records, staff records, examinations, and administrative operations require an authorized account and are not public resources.
